cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone blinked in the family photo. Draw up a blinking rota before we try again. I taught you to count people in, not hope their eyes cooperate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A useful objection, for once. We'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each picture. You can lead the count the way we practised.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Grandma's taxi comes in ten minutes. That rehearsal will take all afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then appoint a timekeeper to approve its length. You used to let rehearsals drift; put Grandma in charge of the clock before we begin.

reason: Give the exact Drive a concrete request, relevant pupil habit and responsive B4 development. Improve weak endings into things A actually needs B to do, without changing playable card wording.
